headline: US Proposes New Tariffs Ranging From 15% to 35% on 14 Trading Partners
summary: The Trump administration proposed additional tariffs ranging from 15% to 35% on imports from 14 trading partners, including China, the European Union, and India, citing excess industrial capacity that distorts global trade.
why: Trade tariffs directly impact import costs, corporate supply chains, and international relations, often triggering retaliatory measures and altering currency and equity valuations across affected regions.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Tariffs target Chinese manufacturing and industrial exports, raising trade friction.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The announcement of aggressive new US tariffs raised fears of a renewed global trade war and retaliatory measures, dampening investor sentiment.
